summary.text: Michael York is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 10, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the September 8 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: York was also a Republican candidate for Cheshire 10 in 2022, when he advanced from the September 13 primary but was not among the winners of the two-seat general election.
